item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 18/Mar/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will affect southern China today and tomorrow. It will be cool in the morning and at night over the region. The band of clouds covering the region will thin out gradually. The weather will improve over the region. With the monsoon moderating, temperatures will rise over Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week to early next week. It will be warm and dry during the day. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. Winds will be weak over the coast of Guangdong midweek next week, visibility will be relatively low.
